item.title: secrets management in practice
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
I spent a while getting secrets management wrong. Here is the version that works for me.

why it matters

Secrets management shows up across devops work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.
  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.
  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

item.title: secrets management in practice
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
I keep coming back to secrets management, so here are the notes I wish I had earlier.

why it matters

Secrets management shows up across devops work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.
  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
